title: 结构泛化的计算复杂度
summary: 本文首次形式化定义了结构泛化，将其转化为数学语言。证明纯Transformer（可学习类⊆TC⁰）在标准假设TC⁰≠NC¹下无法学习结构泛化，而神经符号系统通过注入语义面（G_γ）绕过了这一难题。基准测试无法区分“学习”与“给定”。
summary_en: This paper formally defines structural generalization and proves that pure Transformers (learnable class ⊆ TC⁰) cannot learn it under the standard assumption TC⁰ ≠ NC¹, while neuro-symbolic systems bypass the hard part by injecting the semantic face (G_γ). Benchmarks cannot distinguish 'learned' from 'given'.
